name: Volumetric Code-Block EBCOT
definition: A coding technique using 3D code-blocks (depth > 1) for volumetric data, supported by JP3D but not JPEG 2000 Part 1 or 2 which only support flat code-blocks (depth=1).
summary: Volumetric Code-Block EBCOT is a 3D compression algorithm that extends EBCOT by using 3D code-blocks to exploit inter-slice correlations, offering better compression than 2D methods for volumetric data.
